sample_images_from_3d_points: sample features from 2D feature maps using 3D points and calibrated cameras with grid sampling
normalize_keypoints_to_normalized_coordi: normalize keypoints from pixel coordinates to normalized coordinates in the range of negative one to one
compute_factor_for_normalization: compute the normalization factor by dividing the image size by two for coordinate conversion
convert_pixel_to_coordinates: convert pixel coordinates to normalized coordinates by dividing by the factor and subtracting one
